title: LeetCode 212: Word Search II (Boggle Board)
description: Given an `m x n` board of characters and a list of strings `words`, return all words on the board. Each word must be constructed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells (horizontally or vertically neighboring). The same letter cell may not be used more than once in a word. Return sorted list of found words.
constraints:
m, n <= 12, 1 <= len(words) <= 100
• Time: O(M*N * 4^L) | Space: O(Total Letters)
